summary: TriliumNext Notes is a cross-platform note-taking application designed for constructing large, hierarchical personal knowledge bases. It acts as a continuation of the original Trilium Notes project, helping you organise complex webs of interconnected information in a structured tree format. You can run it self-hosted to maintain full ownership of your data.
goodFor: Users who need to manage extensive, deeply nested personal documentation and want a dedicated self-hosted repository for their notes.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence may have implications if you plan to modify and distribute the code within a networked environment.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, deployment typically involves using Docker or Kubernetes, ensuring you provision persistent storage for your note database and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
